provenance.method_note: Closed-form GP marginal method. EXACT for Gaussian likelihood (no approximation). Equivalent to full 203-dim NUTS analytically; validated empirically at n=40000. Bypasses the 200-dim NCP latent-function space entirely for sampling; f reconstructed exactly via conditional Gaussian after each phi sample. f_raw stored via lossless inverse Cholesky (f_raw = L_K^{-1} @ f, round-trip error ~3e-13). Original single-chain NUTS GT (40k draws, ~63h CPU, 18 divergences) SUPERSEDED. This run achieves 0 divergences and honest between-chain R-hat.
